## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check huntkit tests` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check huntkit tests` passes
- [ ] `mypy huntkit` passes
- [ ] `pytest --cov=huntkit` passes (coverage stays ≥ 90%)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** (if behaviour changed)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or data from unauthorised targets in the diff
